content: I umeqqran n imeɣnajen. Ak-d uzenzun x ifiřan. Azehhed n Asaf, izři.
AREBBI ittwassen di Yahuda, Isem nnes d ameqqran di Israil.
Aɛucci nnes aqa-t di Calim, Tazeddiɣt nnes di Ṣihyun.
Dinni yarẓa fřitcat yareqqen n řqews, taseddart n useřqi d ssif uřa d amenɣi. Silah.
Tessaggʷaded u tjehded i teǧid x idurar nni immeẓren di tkeccaḍt.
Inni izeɛɛamen ttwakeccḍen. Nitni nnudmen, ṭṭṣen, uřa d ijj zeg iryazen imeḥḍen war izemmar ad immɛařa.
S uweddeb nnec, a AREBBI n Yaɛqub, iɣarq ukarru d uyis deg yiḍeṣ.
Cek, wah, Cek tessaggʷaded, wi izemmaren ad iqqim ibedd zzat i wudem nnec, xmi dd ɣa ikkar weɣḍab nnec?
Zeg ujenna teggid ad ittwaseř řḥukm. Teṭṭef teggʷudi tammurt uca tesseɣd,
umi ikkar AREBBI maḥend ad icarreɛ, ḥima ad ifekk marra imhinen n temmurt. Silah.
Maɣar afugem n iwdan ad yawi aqadi i Cek, min iqqimen ɛad n wesɛar ad t tmenɛed.
Wcem lwuɛud u ggem zzaysen zzat i SIDI, AREBBI nwem. Ejj marra inni d as dd-innḍen ad awyen ṣṣdaqi i Wenni ittxeṣṣa ad zzayes ggʷeden,
wenni imennɛen i řḥukkam buḥbeřat nsen, wenni zzayes tteggʷden ijeǧiden n temmurt.
